recorded: Every case passed against both originals: the JavaScript versions with Node.js 26.12.1, run as node {program}.js, and the Python versions with Python 3.15.2, run as python3 with the program's hyphens turned into underscores, as in python3 $(echo {program}.py | tr - _), each beside the decision framework and dataset preparation lessons it imports from, as in the course. Every program uses only the standard library. The reassessment, scaling, and Dolly pipeline tools never touch the network and are deterministic, so their demos are compared exactly and their self-check reports only by their totals, with the titles of the checks free, and the Dolly pipeline tool runs only its self-checks, which write and remove /tmp/teste-dolly-pipeline.jsonl. The Dolly starter reads databricks-dolly-15k.jsonl, which the lesson asks the student to download from Hugging Face, so its first case downloads that public file once, checked by its SHA-256, and prints the numbers the lesson's dataset-real-alternativo-companion.md and model-card-dolly-extra-200.md report (778 LSH candidates, 748 confirmed pairs, 396 removed, 4,071 left, and 71, 66, and 63 per category). The tracking, monitoring, automation, and versioning tools read a tuning job from Vertex AI at a hardcoded regional address, so the copies that produced these cases read GOOGLE_VERTEX_BASE_URL instead, a one-line change at each address in each version, and the cases set TUNING_JOB_NAME, plus GCP_PROJECT_ID for the automation tool, and answer gcloud auth print-access-token with a stand-in that prints a placeholder token, which the replay requires as the bearer token. No Google Cloud project was available, so every job is synthesized from Vertex AI's documented TuningJob format, with int64 fields such as epochCount and the token counts as strings. The production job carries the name, tuned model, endpoint, base model, dataset URI, hyperparameters, create and end times, example count, and 27,353 billable tokens that the lesson's model card reports, the start time behind the tracking tool's own check of 45min41.95s, a display name of its own, and token distributions per example derived from dataset-treinado.jsonl, each text's tokens proportional to its characters and scaled to the billable total, and the versioning tool writes from it the model card the lesson ships, apart from the note its first lines add by hand. The cancelled job of the epochCount 0 incident has no tuned model, no statistics, and no epochCount among its hyperparameters, since proto3 leaves out a zero. The errors follow Google's documented error body: a 404 NOT_FOUND for a job name one digit off, a 503 UNAVAILABLE that the automation tool retries after 3 seconds before waiting 5 seconds for the running job, and a 403 PERMISSION_DENIED it gives up on after three queries in a row. The JavaScript versions report an error status as Falha ao consultar job: with the status and its reason, and Python's urllib as HTTP Error. The Python versions name hyperparameters in snake case, write the model turn's JSON with spaces, print the versioning record's epochs and tokens as numbers, None where JavaScript prints undefined, and the Dolly counts as a dict with single quotes, drop accents and the closing example from the Dolly prose, and write the model card as model-card-amplitude-auto-saude-m3-200-py.md, and the patterns accept either.
